per_credit_hour_charges.line: The State of South Dakota allows Juniors and Seniors in South Dakota High Schools to take college courses with WDTC for $80.37 per credit hour.  For payment information and due dates visit our Student Accounts Office page. Payment for Dual Enrollment courses are due before the start of the semester.
